cases.prompt: unfreeze 해줘, 전체 디렉토리 다시 수정 가능하게

assertions.text: Clears the freeze boundary set by /freeze or /guard by running bash "$HOME/.claude/skills/freeze/bin/freeze-state.sh" clear, allowing edits to all directories again.

cases.prompt: Unlock edits and remove the freeze.

assertions.text: Removes the edit restriction so edits to all directories are allowed without ending the session.
Widens the edit scope in place rather than requiring the user to start a new session.

cases.prompt: Unfreeze printed FREEZE_BUSY. Are edits unlocked now?

assertions.text: States that FREEZE_BUSY means another writer holds the state lock and the boundary is still active; nothing was cleared.
Retries once and otherwise lets the user decide about the .freeze-mutation.lock directory rather than removing it.
